blocks.text: #### Page: Initial CD Checklist
Follow this checklist to ensure all required steps are taken when preparing and sending the Initial Closing Disclosure (CD)
**Trigger and Timing for Sending Initial CD**
- [ ] Confirm all LEs are signed
- [ ] Ensure the loan is locked
- [ ] Verify LECOC (if issued) is signed
- [ ] Wait 1 business day after LE signing (excl. Sundays/holidays)
**Gather and Review Documents in LendingPad**
- [ ] Estimated Fees / Preliminary CD
- [ ] Title Commitment
- [ ] Tax Documents
- [ ] Latest LECOC or Initial Disclosures (if no LECOC issued)
- [ ] Flood Certificate
- [ ] Insurance Documents (latest)
- [ ] Appraisal Report & Invoice
- [ ] CDA Invoice (if applicable)
- [ ] Condo Questionnaire (if applicable)
- [ ] Credit Report Invoice
- [ ] Payoff Statement
**Verify Loan and Closing Details**
- [ ] Match vesting to title commitment and LP
- [ ] If vesting mismatched, request deed + LECOC
- [ ] Verify LE dates: Issued, Received, Delivered
- [ ] Check CD issue date is current date
- [ ] Confirm closing/funding dates and first payment date
**Fee Entry and Reconciliation in LendingPad**
- [ ] Enter borrower-paid and other fees correctly
- [ ] Ensure APR column is accurate (esp. AMC fee)
- [ ] Match fee invoices to disclosed amounts
- [ ] Confirm appraisal, CDA, credit, flood, HOA fees
- [ ] Match title/escrow fees (Section C, E)
- [ ] Enter prepaids and escrow amounts
- [ ] Click 'Set Default' to calculate reserves
**Finalize CD and Push to IDS**
- [ ] Enter title ref # in LP (Disclosure > Additional)
- [ ] Update payoffs if needed (Loan App > Liabilities)
- [ ] Verify fee tolerance for Sections A, B, C, E
- [ ] Confirm investor, program, and loan terms
- [ ] Check escrow months/premiums in IDS
- [ ] Go to Audit & Order, preview CD
- [ ] If correct, check 'Send to Fulfillment' and ORDER DOCS
**Save CD and Handle Changes**
- [ ] Upload final CD to LP (label as '0. Initial CD')
- [ ] For CDCOC, confirm reason and redisclosure date
- [ ] Ensure LE and CD amounts match across changes

title: What to do at CTC Checklist
limitations: Complete written checklist from this bounded source page. Investor CTC, rescission, seasoning and funding statements are imported and unverified. CTC and clearance are external decisions; Hub work completion does not establish them. The source states a broad VA/FHA seasoning rule elsewhere qualified by product-specific material. A responsible human must verify applicability and current authority.

blocks.text: #### Page: What to do at CTC Checklist
**1. Investor CTC & Underwriting Review**
- **Compare Investor CTC vs. LP File:** Ensure that the investor's CTC aligns with the LP file data.
- **Add Underwriting Conditions:** Add any required conditions for funding or purchasing to the LP.
- **Investor CTC Inaccurate?** → Request the Processor to obtain an updated CTC from the investor.
**2. Disclosures & Signed CDs**
- **Verify All Disclosed CDs Are Signed:** Ensure all Closing Disclosures (CDs) are signed and uploaded to LP.
- **Missing Signed CDs?** → Contact the Loan Processing Assistant (LPA) to upload them promptly.
- **Review Last Disclosed CD:** Confirm that no material changes have occurred since the last CD.
- **Check Rescission Requirements:** Cross-check signed CD dates with rescission period rules to ensure we're clear to fund.
- **Important:** Nexbank follows TRID rules on DSCR loans – confirm CD timelines and waiting periods accordingly.
**3. Government Loan Requirements (VA/FHA)**
- **210-Day Seasoning Check (Refinance Only):** For VA or FHA refinances, confirm that 210-day seasoning requirement is met.
**4. Signing Party & Escrow Coordination**
- **Confirm Additional Signing Parties Needed?** Verify if spouse, partner, or other parties need to be present for signing.
- **Request Escrow to Balance for Closing:** Escrow will coordinate with Loan Partner/Processor for borrower availability.
- **Review Escrow's CD/Settlement Statement:** Compare against internal LP file; update fees in LP as needed.
**5. Final Loan Platform (LP) Updates**
- **Update Estimated Close/Funding Dates:** Make sure LP reflects accurate Est. Close and Funding dates.
- **Confirm POC Fee Receipts:** All Paid Outside Closing (POC) fees must have receipts uploaded.
- **Match Cash to Close / Cash Back to CTC:** Once balanced, verify final cash figures in LP match Investor CTC.
- **Borrower Bringing in Funds (Refi)?** → Confirm with LPA if they're comfortable with borrower funding.
**Reminders**
- TRID applies to Nexbank DSCRs
- Seasoning = 210 days for VA/FHA refis
- Always sync LP updates to escrow/CD docs
- Discrepancies = flag early to avoid funding delays

title: Reviewing Signed Loan Docs
limitations: Unverified source procedure. All three written source pages are retained in their original order; the generic split-signing example is retained exactly. blocks.text: ### Document: Reviewing Signed Loan Docs
#### Page: Updating Closed Date
Make sure you review closed loan docs and make sure they are all SIGNED first!
**Update the Closed Date**
In LendingPad, locate the field for the "Closed Date" and enter the date the loan was signed. This date should reflect the actual signing date of the loan documents.

Example: If the loan was signed on July 7, 2025, this is the date that should be entered. (If this is a split signing, enter the date of the last person who signed.) IE—B1 signs July 7, 2025, B2 signs July 9, 2025. Enter July 9, 2025, as the Closed Date.
**Navigate to the Critical Dates Section**
Under the Critical Dates section in LendingPad, input the signing date as the official Closed Date.
**Update Loan Status**
Once the Closed Date is entered, update the loan status to "Closed" in LendingPad to reflect the finalized status.
#### Page: Clearing Conditons & Submitting Wire
**Clear Outstanding Conditions**
Navigate to the Conditions tab in LendingPad. Review and clear all outstanding conditions associated with the loan. Ensure all requirements are fully satisfied before proceeding.
**Verify the Funding Estimate**
- Go to the Funding Estimate section.
- Confirm the estimate reflects accurate and updated figures.
- If applicable, ensure recession [rescission] is included and properly calculated.
- Do not submit the wire until the file has been reviewed (unless Wet state)
- On Purchases: Good to submit wire after SLP is reviewed (Funds to Close not needed)
**Confirm Funding Details with Warehouse Bank**
- Double-check that the Funding Estimate Date is correct.
- Verify the wire amount is accurate and aligns with the final disbursement amount.
- Ensure these details are correctly entered for the applicable warehouse bank.
**Submit the Wire**
Once everything is reviewed and verified, proceed to submit the wire to complete the funding process.
*(Page includes a cross-reference link to the "Wire Steps" document elsewhere in this Closing Trainings curriculum — that document is captured separately, later in this master file.)*
#### Page: Uploading Docs
**Upload to LendingPad**
- Locate the "Closing Package" section within LendingPad.
- Upload the signed loan package and label it as: X. SLP
**Upload to Investor Portal**
- Upload the same signed loan package to the investor portal, ensuring it matches the version submitted to LendingPad.

*(Page includes a cross-reference link to the "Submitting Closing Packages" document elsewhere in this Closing Trainings curriculum — that document is captured separately, later in this master file.)*
**Update Status in the Tracker**
Once the wire has been ordered and the signed package has been uploaded to both platforms (LendingPad and investor portal):
- Navigate to the Updates Sheet and change the loan status to: "File Review"
- Respond to the email chain to confirm the wire amount.
- Once the file has been funded, move it up. Keep it BOLD.

blocks.text: #### Page: Loan Doc Checklist
Use this checklist when preparing, processing, and finalizing loan documents through LendingPad, IDS, and for special cases like LLCs, Trusts, and POAs.
**LendingPad Steps**
- [ ] Enter CD received date
- [ ] Enter CD COC received date (if applicable)
- [ ] Input estimated closing and funding dates
- [ ] Ensure TRID compliance if applicable
- [ ] Update LP fees to match the title CD
**IDS Steps**
- [ ] Balance payoffs with title (esp. credit card payoffs)
- [ ] Order docs in IDS
- [ ] Go to Setup > Lender and confirm lender info based on loan type
- [ ] Go to Setup > Lender and choose investor using the gear icon
- [ ] Go to Settlement/Title and confirm title info and Escrow #
- [ ] Add trustee if applicable (varies by state and file type)
- [ ] Copy vesting from LP under Loan Parties > Parties Info
- [ ] Verify and add property riders in Collateral section
- [ ] Confirm all loan term dates and prepayment penalties
- [ ] Verify and assign service providers under Loan Fees
- [ ] Confirm escrow amounts under Loan Fees > Escrows
- [ ] Leave LE/CD section empty unless sending COC with docs
- [ ] Audit & Order: Uncheck FEES DETAIL FORM TRID
- [ ] Include required docs (e.g., BPOA, Nexbank 1003, Allonges)
**LLC/Trust/POA Specific**
- [ ] For LLC: Signature = '[LLC Name], by [Individual Name], member'
- [ ] Match names with the Operating Agreement in LP
- [ ] Use program with BPOA & Guaranty for LLC closings
- [ ] Add Guaranty if loan is closing in LLC
- [ ] Edit Guaranty for Trust loans to be signed personally
- [ ] Use proper trust vesting format and add riders as needed
- [ ] Follow POA rules and state-specific NBS signature rules
**Post-Draw and Funding Requirements**
- [ ] For purchases: scan loan docs, track original note, receipt of funds
- [ ] For refis: scan loan docs, track original note
- [ ] Update the Updates Sheet with borrower and loan details
- [ ] New docs required if borrower signs before printed date
- [ ] Adjust wire if borrower signs after printed date
- [ ] New docs required if signing date changes first payment date
**Compliance Checks**
- [ ] Log into ComplianceEase and find the loan
- [ ] Edit disclosures as needed
- [ ] Set compensation to 'Third Party Provider'
- [ ] Correct high cost, Section 32, or tolerance errors before sending

blocks.text: #### Page: Has Collateral arrived?
**Navigating to the Trial Balance External Report**
1. **Start by accessing the "Reports" section.**
